title: Pointwise limits of marked sections of a cocartesian fibration
statement: Use the quasicategories, coherent functors and limits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], in fixed nested universes. Let $p:E\to S$ be a cocartesian fibration of quasicategories, $g:T\to S$ a functor with $T$ small, $J$ a small simplicial set, and $W$ a set of edges of $T$. Write $\operatorname{Sect}_W(g^*E)$ for the full infinity subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}_S(T,E)$ consisting of functors carrying each edge in $W$ to a $p$-cocartesian edge. Suppose every fiber $E_{g(t)}$ admits $J$-indexed limits and, for each $w:t\to t'$ in $W$, its transport $g(w)_!:E_{g(t)}\to E_{g(t')}$ preserves those limits. Then $\operatorname{Fun}_S(T,E)$ admits $J$-indexed limits computed in the fibers, and $\operatorname{Sect}_W(g^*E)$ is closed under them. Evaluation at all vertices of $T$ jointly detects limit cones in this full subcategory. Equivalently its inclusion creates these limits. No preservation of limits by transports on unmarked arrows is assumed. The empty shape $J=\varnothing$ is included.

source.place: Agent-formulated marked-section theorem underlying Section 3.2.2, especially the proof of Proposition 3.2.2.1 and Corollaries 3.2.2.3-3.2.2.5, printed pp.357-364; not a direct application of their symmetric-operad statements. It is the general relative-limit/relative right Kan extension argument for a cocartesian fibration, using HTT Proposition 4.3.1.10 and Corollary 4.3.1.11. Report.md gives the argument and makes explicit why it is independent of symmetry. Read from retained sandbox source; full shared archive WANTED in report.md. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical result.
